sn16.10:1.6: Dutiyam pi kho āyasmā Ānando āyasmantam MahāKassapam etad avoca || ||

sn16.10:2.1: Atha kho āyasmā Mahā-Kassapo pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivasetvā pattacīvaram ādāya āyasmatā Ānandena pacchā samaṇena yena aññataro bhikkhunupassayo tenupasaṅkami || || Upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi || || 7
sn16.10:2.2: Atha kho sambahulā bhikkhuniyo yenāyasmā MahāKassapo tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Mahā-Kassapaṃ abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdiṃsu || || 8
sn16.10:2.3: Ekam antaṃ nisinnā kho tā bhikkhuniyo āyasmā Mahā-Kassapo dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi || || 9
sn16.10:2.4: Atha kho āyasmā Mahā-Kassapo tā bhikkhuniyo dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi || || 10
sn16.10:3.1: Atha kho Thullatissā bhikkhunī anattamanā anattamanavācaṃ nicchāresi || ||
sn16.10:3.2: Kim pana ayyo Mahā-Kassapo ayyassa Ānandassa vedehamunino sammukhā dhammam bhāsitabbam maññati ||
sn16.10:3.3: seyyathāpi nāma sūcivānijako sūcikārassa santike sūcim vikketabbam maññeyya ||
sn16.10:3.4: evam eva ayyo Mahā-Kassapo ayyassa Ānandassa vedehamunino sammukhā dhammam bhāsitabbam maññātīti || || 11
sn16.10:4.1: Assosi kho āyasmā Mahā-Kassapo Thullatissāya bhikkhuniyā imaṃ vācam bhāsamānāya || || 12
sn16.10:4.2: Atha kho āyasmā Mahā-Kassapo āyasmantam Ānandam etad avoca || ||
sn16.10:4.3: Kiṃ nu kho āvuso Ānanda || ahaṃ sucivāṇijako tvam sucikāro
sn16.10:4.5: Khamatha bhante Kassapa bālo mātugāmo ti || || 13
sn16.10:4.6: Āgamehi tvam āvuso Ānanda mā te saṃgho uttariupaparikkhi || ||
